notes.problem: Biktima is victim or prey, not Eaten. The prey toasts can keep biktima. dEaten Kinain is already the eaten word.
Init is heat, not temperature. The top bar shows degrees, and cold stress is also a temp death.
Same heat word on the death cause. Starved already uses Pagkagutom, not Gutom, so this cause can use the full temperature word.
SIMULA is the noun beginning, not the start command. The primary button can hold the verb.
Ikaw ay is textbook ay-inversion. The other lines are informal.

notes.problem: Dami max leaves English max after the noun.
Ayos as a screen title also means OK or fine. The button AYOS can stay.
PAANO MAGLARO is 13 characters on the small menu button. English HOW TO PLAY is 11. The help title uses the same key.
Maliliit na kumakain is 20 characters and wraps the category chip. kumakain is the right eater.
Mga gitnang kumakain is 20 characters on the same chip.
Malalaking mangangaso is 21 characters. Malaking mangangaso is 19 and may still wrap. Do not shorten mangangaso to aso (that is dog).
Tagalinis (kabute) is 18 characters and may wrap, but kabute is the fungi word. Do not shorten it to singaw (that is steam).
pond is English on purpose. lawa is a lake. Do not revert menuSub or wikiT to lawa.

notes.problem: তাপ is heat, not temperature. The top bar is তাপ: 20°C. Cold stress is also a temp death.
Same heat word on the death cause.
খেয়ে ফেলা is the act of devouring, not Eaten. The eaten stat খাওয়া is the closer word. English uses Eaten for both.
চালিয়ে যাও is the right continue, but it is wide next to কীভাবে খেলবে on the 390 pause row. চালাও is the short run-it resume. Do not use a share-word.
ভিনয়েট is an opaque loan. Players will not read it as the darkened-edge effect.
বিভাজন is the division word and matches the short label, divs, the goal line, and the toasts. Do not revert to ভাগ (that is share).
Same division word. 4 graphemes fits the short HUD budget. Do not shorten it to ভাগ.
বন্ধ করো is the close command. বন্ধ alone is closed or off. Do not shorten it back.
সিস্ট is the cyst and স্পোর is the spore. Do not merge them, and do not use a sister-word.
notes.fix: ক্ষুধা: সিস্ট হয়েছ — খাবার খুঁজে জেগে ওঠো
